messages: Maya: quick design check — I'm seeing a weird VO (VoiceOver) read order in the Vectors Preview when using compact rows. Screenshot: https://figma.redwood/internal/vec-preview-compact.png Maya: in compact mode VO reads the row header, then value, then repeats the value again. can't repro in comfortable. anyone seen this? Arjun: I can repro on mac + VO. suspect we left a hidden duplicate for layout purposes and forgot aria-hidden. compact collapses some labels into stacked spans. Lena: yep that's typical. voiceover will read both visible and SR-only nodes if aria-hidden isn't set correctly. also check focus order — when you arrow into the list VO sometimes jumps to the inspector button and reads that before the row content. Tom: product input: compact is high signal for power users (more rows/page) but accessibility must be first-class. proposal: default to comfortable, add opt-in "Compact rows" toggle with an explanatory tooltip. Priya: perf note — compact increases DOM density which slightly impacts repaint cost for huge batches. that's OK if it's opt-in. we'll need to test large exports with compact on. Maya: copy idea for the toggle: "Compact rows — Show more items per page (opt-in)". short, explains trade-off. any wording suggestions? Nelly: nit: can we add the tooltip text to the accessibility docs and include keyboard shortcut? also export CSV header ordering — current export spits [id, vector, metadata, score] but the table shows [checkbox, id, score, metadata]. should match UI order. Arjun: agreed on CSV. i'll change export mapping. keyboard nav fix: when inspector opens we should focus first actionable inside panel not the close X. currently focus lands on close which is confusing for VO users. Lena: aria suggestions: 1) for numeric relevance/score, keep a single SR-only label and mark the visible number aria-hidden="true"; 2) add aria-describedby on the row for the short relevance explanation; 3) consider a "Skip to preview list" link for keyboard users. Maya: example for hiding visual duplicate (quick): ```html Relevance: 0.87 0.87 ``` Maya: this prevents VO from reading the visible duplicate while keeping semantic text. Arjun: I'll implement that pattern + ensure focus order in the list component (tabindex adjustments). i'll open a PR and tag you all. Priya: i'll add an integration test for export header order + a stress test for compact rows with 100k vectors in CI. Nelly: :thumbsup: can we also evaluate density preference in user settings? small persistent opt-in so people don't have to toggle per session. Tom: sounds good. Maya — can you update the figma to show both row heights and the tooltip/copy? then we can run a 10-min usability check with 3 participants next week. Maya: yep will update figma, add the copy above, and create a short checklist for the usability run. @Arjun i'll ping you when the PR lands. thanks all!
